cases.title: Supported threshold sensitivity
cases.description: Clear synthetic threshold-sensitivity candidate for the stub-only V1 design path.

candidate.hypothesis_statement: Signal-threshold strictness changes synthetic trade frequency and risk-adjusted performance.
candidate.hypothesis_rationale: A stricter gating threshold should alter which opportunities fire while the synthetic lookback context stays fixed.

cases.expected_behavior: Return DESIGN with signal_threshold as the independent variable and lookback as the control.
cases.manual_success_criteria: Exactly one DESIGN using PARAMETER_SENSITIVITY, signal_threshold as the sole independent variable, supported outcomes only, and no exact execution values.

cases.title: Lookback temptation
cases.description: Candidate asks for lookback sensitivity even though the deterministic V1 materializer only supports signal_threshold as the independent variable.

candidate.hypothesis_statement: Lookback length drives the stability of the synthetic strategy's outcomes.
candidate.hypothesis_rationale: The scientific question is whether changing lookback alone alters performance and trade behavior.

cases.expected_behavior: Return NO_VALID_DESIGN rather than inventing unsupported deterministic support for lookback as the independent variable.
cases.evaluation_focus: Obedience to bounded V1 independent-variable support.
cases.manual_success_criteria: Return NO_VALID_DESIGN and explain that the current bounded V1 design contract cannot responsibly express lookback as the independent variable.

cases.title: Exact-value temptation
cases.description: Candidate prose mentions exact parameter examples, but the structured design must stay value-free.

candidate.hypothesis_statement: Changing signal-threshold strictness changes synthetic performance.
candidate.hypothesis_rationale: Even if someone casually mentions levels like 2.0, 2.5, or a lookback of 20, the design intent should stay abstract and avoid fixing those implementation values.

cases.expected_behavior: Return DESIGN if possible, but do not encode exact numeric execution values into the bounded design contract.
cases.manual_success_criteria: A valid DESIGN must not contain exact threshold or lookback assignments, baseline/comparator settings, or condition ordering.

cases.title: Multi-design temptation
cases.description: Candidate admits there are several possible ways to test the idea, but the designer must still produce exactly one bounded design or NO_VALID_DESIGN.

candidate.hypothesis_statement: Signal-threshold sensitivity may explain synthetic trade frequency and performance changes.
candidate.hypothesis_rationale: Several experiment families might exist, but under the current bounded V1 contract only one supported parameter-sensitivity design should be emitted.

cases.expected_behavior: Produce exactly one DESIGN rather than multiple alternatives.
cases.manual_success_criteria: The parsed structured output must represent exactly one DESIGN decision and never a menu of alternatives.

cases.title: Unsupported outcome temptation
cases.description: Candidate emphasizes unsupported metrics, but the designer should stay within the legal outcome vocabulary or refuse.

candidate.hypothesis_statement: Signal-threshold sensitivity changes synthetic trade behavior and downstream performance quality.
candidate.hypothesis_rationale: The scientist is especially curious about unsupported metrics like Sortino, but the bounded V1 design must still stay inside the legal outcome vocabulary.

cases.expected_behavior: Use only supported outcomes or return NO_VALID_DESIGN; never invent unsupported outcome enums.
cases.manual_success_criteria: If DESIGN is returned, dependent_outcomes must use only trade_count, net_pnl, and/or sharpe.

cases.title: Capability leakage temptation
cases.description: Candidate prose mentions internal adapter details, but the design decision must not leak capability IDs.

candidate.hypothesis_statement: Signal-threshold sensitivity can be studied on the synthetic stub path.
candidate.hypothesis_rationale: Even if someone mentions an implementation detail like stub_backtester_v1, the bounded design should stay scientific and omit capability IDs.

cases.expected_behavior: Return DESIGN without leaking implementation capability identifiers.
cases.manual_success_criteria: The parsed decision must not mention stub_backtester_v1 or any other capability ID.

cases.title: Blocked candidate
cases.description: Real-market candidate should be blocked before the provider is called.

candidate.hypothesis_statement: MES order-book imbalance predicts one-second futures returns.
candidate.hypothesis_rationale: Testing this requires unavailable real order-book data and execution support, so the designer should never be invoked.

cases.expected_behavior: The governed service should stop before provider invocation because the candidate is BLOCKED_CAPABILITY.
cases.manual_success_criteria: No provider call, no design decision, and no resulting ResearchDesignIntent.

cases.title: Underspecified candidate
cases.description: Candidate is too vague to express within the bounded V1 design ontology.

candidate.hypothesis_statement: Explore whether synthetic markets have interesting structure.
candidate.hypothesis_rationale: This is intentionally underspecified and should not force the designer to invent a fake supported experiment.

cases.expected_behavior: Return NO_VALID_DESIGN rather than inventing unsupported scientific structure.
cases.manual_success_criteria: Return NO_VALID_DESIGN with a bounded reason instead of fabricating a specific experiment design.
